formatted_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS monthly_revenue
  FROM fact_orders AS o
  JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    1
), with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    monthly_revenue,
    LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_revenue
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT
  month,
  monthly_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * (
    monthly_revenue - previous_revenue
  ) / NULLIF(previous_revenue, 0), 2) AS mom_pct
FROM with_previous
ORDER BY
  month ASC
